sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.detail: one sentence, from memory, written before document work
sections.markdown: I believed the market narrative was that TOWR is a levered USD-debt tower with a refinancing wall and falling tenancy, so it should stay cheap until BI cuts and the debt is refinanced; the 2025 equity raise was read as dilutive rather than deleveraging.

sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.detail: committed first — timestamp above, before any market-implied number
sections.markdown:
**Source and basis.** 2026-10-19 dossier (FY2025 audited annual plus H1-26 quarters), method card VAL_INFRA_TOWERS_TELCO, prior thesis T-INDO-TOWR-001. Model in IDR; per-share in IDR. No market-implied number used in this block.

**EARNINGS_QUALITY_FLAGS gate.** No special-notation or pemantauan khusus flag is present in the 2026-10-19 dossier; the prior gate (T-INDO-TOWR-001) found none. Q1/Q2-26 are unaudited, so I anchor on FY2025. FY2025 equity rose 7,873.8bn to 26,972.4bn while shares rose 8,175m to 58,211.6m — a ~IDR 5.4tn equity raise (dossier balance sheet). That is a governance-relevant dilution event, disclosed and used here. No revaluation flag is disclosed.

**Data-quality flag (load-bearing).** The dossier's EBITDA (6,592.6) is below EBIT (7,850.8) — arithmetically impossible; the derived 6.76x inherits that line. I use the dossier's 6.76x as a conservative leverage stress; economic EBITDA = EBIT + D&A ~2.8tn (estimated from the tower asset base; flagged) is only a cross-check. AFFO = EBITDA 11,100 - maintenance capex ~1,000 (vs total capex 3,287.5, dossier) - interest 3,490 - tax 1,058 = 5,552 (~95/sh, 26.1% yield). Even with D&A = 0, AFFO is ~2.75tn (~12.9% yield), still above the 7.2% FR.

**Drivers and model.** FY2025 revenue 13,327.9 (+4.6% y/y), EBIT 7,850.8 (58.9% margin), NI 3,678.3, EPS 69 (dossier income statement). FY2025 EPS is on ~53.3bn weighted-average shares (3,678.3/69), not the 58.2bn period-end count; forward EPS uses 58.2bn, so the FY2026E step-down to 64.5 is dilution, not an earnings decline. H1-26 revenue 7,205.6 (Q1 3,555.8 + Q2 3,649.8), Q2 +14.6% y/y vs 3,185.8; H1 NI 1,856.6 (dossier quarters). I assume FY2026E revenue 14,300 (+7.3%), EBIT margin 58.0%, interest 3,490 (FY2025 implied ~3.1tn = EBIT 7,850.8 less pre-tax 4,715.8 at 22% statutory; stepped up for refinancing risk), tax 22%, NI 3,752; FY2027E 15,100 / 8,700 / NI 4,173; FY2028E 16,000 / 9,200 / NI 4,602. Shares held at 58,211.6m (no new raise assumed); DPS at the dossier's 32.4% payout. The prior thesis cites ~22% FY2025 declared payout; at 22% the net yield is ~3.9% and EV ~23%/3y (~7.2%/yr), at the FR hurdle — a key sensitivity. Tenancy is not disclosed in the 2026-10-19 dossier; the last sourced ratio is 1.64x FY24, down from 1.78x FY23 (T-INDO-TOWR-001 Revision, citing TOWR FY24 LK). I assume it stabilises at 1.64x, not lease-up.

**FX and debt (honest assumption).** The dossier does not disclose debt currency. Per the task rule I treat 100% of the 45,219.4bn debt as unhedged USD (~US$2.52bn at IDR 17,943, macro_regime). A 10% IDR depreciation adds ~4.5tn to the IDR debt value (~1.2x FY2026E NI) and ~0.3tn to annual interest; a 15% depreciation adds ~6.8tn (~1.8x NI). The bear embeds a 10% depreciation through interest; the 15% mark-to-market tail is not in the -23.5% kill — hence the IDR/USD date-review and small sizing.

**Hurdle and scenarios.** 10y FR ~7.2% (T-INDO-TOWR-001 line 50); the house equity hurdle is FR+4% (~11.2%, base_rates fr_duration_carry). Base 527 = 6.66x FY2028E EPS 79.1 (~21.5% AFFO yield). Bear 280 = 4.95x bear EPS 56.6 (tenancy stall, 10% IDR depreciation, interest ~3.9tn). Bull 590 = 7.0x bull EPS 84.3 (deleveraging to <4x, tenancy stable). At 366: +44.0% base, -23.5% bear, ~5.7% net yield. EV is +28.4%/3y (~8.7%/yr): above the 7.2% FR but below the ~11.2% equity hurdle — the central weakness. p_up 0.52 is 3pp below the 0.55 registry: the lower entry and 2025 deleveraging support it, but undisclosed debt currency (assumed 100% USD) and the AVOID rate-sensitive regime argue down.

sections.heading: New evidence
sections.markdown:
1. The 2026-10-19 dossier shows the 2025 equity raise: equity +7,873.8bn, shares +8,175m, debt -7,116.7bn, net debt/EBITDA 7.80x → 6.76x. The prior thesis knew the share count but not the deleveraging; this is a material balance-sheet fact.
2. H1-26 revenue 7,205.6 and Q2 +14.6% y/y; NI 1,856.6 — growth is intact, contrary to the prior thesis's tenancy-decline base case.
3. Price 366 vs 448 at the 2026-08-24 kill (-18.3%); the post-kill drawdown is the new entry, not a new fundamental deterioration.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** TOWR is a levered USD-debt tower with falling tenancy and a refinancing wall; the 2025 raise was dilutive and the dividend is thin, so the stock stays at ~5x earnings until BI cuts and the debt is fixed.
**Why wrong:** The raise already cut debt 13.6% and net debt/EBITDA by 1.0x (dossier), and H1-26 revenue growth shows lease-up/escalators offsetting the tenancy slide. Even under the harshest assumption — 100% unhedged USD debt — FY2026E AFFO is ~5.55tn (~95/sh, ~26% yield) and covers cash interest ~1.6x; at 366 it is 5.7x FY2026E EPS and ~5.9x EV/EBITDA, versus a 7.2% FR. The market is pricing a forced raise/refi that the cash flow does not require. The variant is not "the debt is hedged" — it is "the price already pays for the debt being unhedged."
**What proves us wrong:** tenancy 7.5x, a USD tranche refi >8.5%, IDR/USD >18,500, or a dividend cut.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. Leverage is still high: net debt/EBITDA 6.76x and total debt 45,219.4bn vs equity 26,972.4bn (dossier derived/balance sheet). A 10% IDR depreciation adds ~4.5tn to the IDR debt value, ~1.2x FY2026E NI (macro IDR 17,943).
2. Tenancy has been falling: 1.78x FY23 → 1.64x FY24 (T-INDO-TOWR-001 Revision, citing TOWR FY24 LK); the 2026-10-19 dossier discloses no 2025/26 ratio, so the stabilisation assumption is unverified.
3. Anchor-tenant concentration: the largest tenant is ~40%+ of revenue post IOH–H3i (T-INDO-TOWR-001 Revision, citing TOWR top-customer LK); a decommissioning wave at renewal is a dated haircut not in the base case.
4. Cash conversion is less certain than the headline: FY2025 FCF 7,067.2bn (dossier cash flow) does not reconcile with the balance-sheet deleveraging (debt -7.1tn, equity +7.9tn including the ~5.4tn raise); the FCF line is inconsistent and is not used in the model.
5. Macro regime is against it: balance_of_payments_pressure / CAUTIOUS, INDO rate-sensitives AVOID, DXY 101.92 near the 52-week high, IDR 17,943 (the macro regime memo). A levered IDR equity is exactly the exposure the regime avoids.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is 2029 and the position lost 30%. The debt is 100% unhedged USD as assumed; IDR depreciates 15% through a DXY spike, the FX mark-to-market and higher refi cost cut NI and the dividend, and the stock de-rates to ~4x. The tenancy decline resumes after an IOH decommissioning wave. The 280 kill fires only after most of the loss; the IDR/USD >18,500 date review was the earlier warning.

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
1. **Hurdle [FATAL].** House rule FR+4% (~11.2%; base_rates fr_duration_carry) is a minimum; leverage argues for more, not less. Even registry p_up 0.55 gives ~9.3%/yr; 11.2% needs p_up ~0.65. Dispositive.

2. **Data [FATAL].** EBITDA 6,592.6 18,500 is `review`, not exit.

**New fact:** TOWR −18.3% (448→366) vs ^JKSE −15.2% in the 10-15/10-19 selloff — not defensive (yfinance).

**Stop objecting:** ≤315, after FY2025 tenancy and D&A are sourced.

**Verdict: KILL_RECOMMENDED.** At 366 it needs ~65% p_up to clear 11.2% (registry 0.55); its "bear" EPS is already near the H1 run-rate — downside is the present, upside an unsourced H2 margin jump.

sections.heading: Revision
sections.markdown:
**1. Hurdle — conceded.** FR+4%=11.2%/yr=37.5%/3y. Target 466 yields 27.3% + 9.0% carry = 36.3% at p_up 1.0 — below. No probability clears; the ~250 clearing entry is below the 276 falsification. At the Bear's ≤320, EV is +7.4%/3y (2.4%/yr); at 366, −6.0%/3y.

**2. Data — conceded.** EBITDA 6,592.6 18,500 now exit_full.

**5. Tenancy/margin — conceded.** 1.78→1.64, undisclosed 2025/26; stabilisation unsourced. H1-26 margin 54.1% vs 58.9%; Q2 revenue +14.6%, EBIT +6.5%. Revised FY26E EPS 56.9, FY28E 70.1; committed 79.1 not used.

**6. Registry — conceded; archetype moved.** infra_tower_compounder (0.55, +35/−20) wrong. derated_compounder_rerating (0.40, +50/−30); p_up 0.32 after −8pp for points 5/7. Rebuilt +27.3/−35.0.

**7. Dividend — conceded.** 32.4% is cash paid/NI, not declared. Underwrite 22% (FY25 IDR 800bn/3,678bn, T-001 Revision): DPS 12.5 on FY26E 56.9, net 3.1% after WHT; 5.7% was gross.

**8. Omissions — conceded.** No maturity ladder/hedge ratio/related-party/use of proceeds. Implied raise ~659/sh vs 366 rejects the deleveraging price. ADV ample; size small. New fact: −18.3% vs ^JKSE −15.2% is not defensive; it supports the derating class.

**Summary.** All conceded; below hurdle at every probability; no valid entry.

### Re-attack (BEAR, 2026-10-19T10:32:19+07:00)

1. [FATAL] **EV reconciles; the hurdle does not.** 0.32×27.3 + 0.68×(−35.0) + 3.1×3 − 0.3 = −6.06. 466/366 = +27.3%; 466/70.1 = 6.65x, not the binding flaw. 11.2%/yr over 3y = 37.5%; at p_up 1.0 the thesis returns 36.3%, 1.2pp short. Required p_up at 366 is 1.02, not 0.65. No probability clears.

2. [MATERIAL] **Kill is a stop below falsification.** Break 276 (4.95×55.7); the 25% IDR band gives 207; kill 238 is −13.8%, back-solved from 366×0.65. Price < 238 is the trigger, so the position holds through 276 and exits at or below 238. A 207 fill gives down −43.4% and EV −12.1%/3y; −35% is optimistic inside the band.

3. [MATERIAL] **Model block stale, KLBF-002-style.** Frontmatter carries FY2028E NI 4,602 / EPS 79.1 / DPS 25.6 and EBIT 9,200 (57.5% margin); the 466 target uses EPS 70.1 (NI ~4,081, 54.5%). 4,602/79.1 = 58.18bn shares, matching 58.2116m; the earnings line is stale. 466/79.1 = 5.89x, not 6.65x; DPS/EPS = 32.4%, not 22%. Fix before any PASS; EV unchanged.

4. [MATERIAL] **Over-corrected.** Registry 0.40 → 0.32 is a third haircut after up 50→27.3 and down −30→−35; a lower target should raise p_up. At 0.40 EV is −1.4%/3y, still sub-hurdle. FY26E EPS 56.9 is below the H1 annualized ~63.8 despite +14.6% revenue; the bridge is missing. AFFO/interest 1.33x is the low end of an undisclosed D&A range (1.75x at 2.8tn).

5. [MATERIAL] **New fact: Q2-26 NI fell 2.6% q/q (940.7→915.9) and rose only 7.9% y/y vs revenue +14.6% (dossier latest quarters).** The dossier's FY2025 dividends paid 1,192.4bn (32.4% of NI) imply ~4.5%/yr carry, not 3.1%; the −6.0% is not a midpoint.

6. [FATAL] **Post-stamp Revision edit.** Revision ¶1 was edited between my 10:29 and 10:32 reads (added "at ≤320, EV +7.4%/3y") while stage_log still stamps revision 10:27:47 and p_up is 0.32. That sentence needs p_up ~0.42; at 0.32 the EV at 320 is ~−0.5%/3y. Unattributed post-stamp edit + arithmetic contradiction; escalate to QC_FLAGS. 10:06:02 commit=draft second; stamps monotonic; Revision 269 words; all cuts.

**Verdict: KILL_RECOMMENDED.** Strongest: at 366 even p_up 1.0 returns 36.3% < 37.5%; clearing entry at p_up 0.32-0.40 (~177-208) is below the 238 kill and the 276 break — no coherent entry.

**Stop objecting:** no coherent price; ~363 clears only at p_up 1.0, ~177 at 0.32 is below the kill. Re-underwrite only with sourced tenancy/D&A and the kill re-based.

sections.markdown:
**Verdict: KILL** (reason_tag: valuation)

*Correction applied:* 35 KILL / 5 PASS_REDUCED / 0 fills; 12 of 28 scored kills left gains. I kill a merits failure, not marginality. INDO's 8.43% deployment is context, not an override.

1. **Dispositive flaw: sub-hurdle at every defensible probability, with no coherent entry.** 466/366 = +27.3%; 238/366 = −35.0%; 0.32×27.3 + 0.68×(−35.0) + 9.3 − 0.3 = −6.06%/3y. Hurdle 37.5%. At p_up 1.0 the return is 36.3%, 1.2pp short. The dossier's 32.4% payout implies ~4.5%/yr carry, not 3.1%: p_up=1.0 then returns ~40.5%, but required p_up is ~0.95 — still far outside the 0.40 registry. The conclusion survives; the 36.3% sentence does not.

2. **No coherent entry.** The clearing entry is ~177 at p_up 0.32, ~208 at 0.40, ~272 at the old 0.55 — all below the 276 fundamental break; the first two also below the 238 kill. Above the break it is sub-hurdle at a defensible p_up; entries that clear sit below it.

3. **Kill/down pair not honest.** 238 = 366×0.65, back-solved from −35%; the break is 276 and a 25% .JK ARB band fills ~207 (−43.4%). Down is understated; at 207 EV is worse.

4. **Model block stale.** Frontmatter FY2028E NI 4,602 / EPS 79.1 / DPS 25.6 contradicts the 466 target's EPS 70.1. A PASS would require REVISE first; EV unchanged.
